description: A row on a finite atom set extends to a valuation by retaining its values on that set and assigning false to every other atom.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.extendRow.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (r : ↥s → Bool) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α
